entities.name: Alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase C
observations: The 505-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Aspergillus fumigatus proteins B0XQB2 and Q4WTB3; identity and coverage are 100%.
Annotated EC 3.2.1.55; hydrolyzes terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues, especially small linear 1,5-alpha-linked L-arabinofuranosyl oligosaccharides.
Annotated as secreted and associated with the extracellular region.
Pfam domains: ASD1_dom (PF22848.3; residues 67-239) and Alpha-L-AF_C (PF06964.19; residues 308-496).
Associated with arabinoxylan/arabinan degradation, polysaccharide catabolism, and L-arabinose metabolism.
Sequence-derived size is 505 aa and approximately 56.6 kDa; predicted pI is 5.37.

entities.name: B0XQB2
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Aspergillus fumigatus; exact sequence match to the query; annotated probable alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase C.
